items.q: he is such a hero to me. He’s maybe ten years or eleven years that he was our principal conductor.

ctx.x: Yeah. And that’s how we do it in the WDR Big Band too. And most of the writers already know anyway who to write the piccolo part for, or the alto flute part, or the clarinet solo. They know, or they ask. Or even when there are solos, where one of us feels more comfortable in this stylistic environment or not so comfortable in that, then we just pass it around. It’s really very easygoing, everything. Because you know when you play music together almost every single day there’s no room for ego and for all that…
